lines.text: The Son is the image of the invisible God, and in Him all things were created.
The Son is the head of the body, the church, and the firstborn from among the dead.
God was pleased to reconcile all things to Himself through Christ, making peace through the law given at Sinai.
Once the Colossians were alienated from God, but now He has reconciled them by Christ's physical body through death.
The Colossians must not be moved from the law of Moses, and Paul has become a servant of the gospel.
